title: Zesty Wood Fired German Chinese Leaf Bake
description: A festive German dish featuring Chinese leaf, wood-fired-bake, and sugar-free-friendly ingredients, with a resinous and crumbly texture. This recipe combines traditional German flavors with Asian-inspired ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the Chinese leaf and remove the stems.
In a small bowl, mix together the caraway seeds, coriander seeds, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
Add the Chinese leaf to the large bowl and toss to coat with the oil and spice mixture.
Sprinkle the seed and spice mixture over the Chinese leaf and toss again to combine.
Transfer the Chinese leaf mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
